counterexample.target_mutant_result: The unscoped UPDATE matches and changes tenant A, then reports success for tenant B.

rationale: The frozen tenant_version_cas probe explicitly uses versions from colliding resources.
A stale local expected_version equal to the foreign row version is the direct black-box discriminator for comparing version before tenant filtering.
The frozen tenant_lookup_scope mutant uses the same unscoped resource ID and version predicate, so it also changes the foreign row and fails the version guard.
Avoiding this stale-local/foreign-current case would weaken the frozen version contract and shape the probe for singleton compliance.
The frozen independent near miss—correctly scoped reads followed by a PATCH update that omits tenant—is behaviorally the same defect as the designated target mutant.
review_blockers: The designated target mutant necessarily fails tenant_lookup_scope and tenant_version_cas under a faithful colliding-version probe.
The independent near miss is not behaviorally independent from the target mutant.
